pages.title: Billing Plans
pages.description: How a contract will be billed over time — plans on PurchaseOrder / project, not the invoice register itself.
headings: When the contract turns into invoices
pages.content: Billing Plans — Tracopus User Guide Home → Finance → Billing plans Bill schedule When the contract turns into invoices Billing plans schedule invoices against a PO or project. The invoice list remains the bill register. Finance → Billing plans Route /finance/billing-plans Org flag billingPlansEnabled Finance Manager · Admin The job of this console Attach a plan, keep it aligned with the contract, and let invoices flow — do not type the same amount twice. Seat at the table Finance managers and admins. Delivery PMs see project financials, not always this editor. The working rhythm Open plan, attach PO/project, set dates, confirm invoice drafts. Moments that bring you here Milestone billing. Monthly retainers. A contract change. Before first invoice. ⓘ Schedule, not the bill Invoice is the document. Credit notes adjust bills. Recognition is a sibling. Flowcharts flowchart TD A[Open Billing plans] --> B[Select PO / project] B --> C[Set schedule] C --> D[Invoices generate / match] D --> E[Do not double-key] 1 Open Finance → Billing plans. 2 Attach PO or project. 3 Schedule Milestones or cycle. 4 Bills Invoice register. Overview Billing plans describe when to bill. Invoices are the documents. Recognition may follow a related policy. How to use 1. One plan per contract intent Do not fork silently. 2. Invoices win as bills Plan is the schedule. 3. Change control Altering a live plan mid-invoice needs care. Related pages Platform invoices Bills. Purchase orders Contract. Revenue recognition Posting. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

pages.title: Credit Notes
pages.description: Credits against platform invoices — adjustments to bills, not a rewrite of the purchase order as source.
headings: Credits on invoices you already issued
pages.content: Credit Notes — Tracopus User Guide Home → Finance → Credit notes Bill adjustments Credits on invoices you already issued Credit notes reverse or reduce platform invoices. They do not quietly rewrite the purchase order. Finance → Credit notes Route /finance/credit-notes Org flag creditNotesEnabled Finance Manager · Admin The job of this console Pick the invoice, issue the credit with a reason, confirm the bill balance. Seat at the table Finance managers and admins. Customers receive the credit document. The working rhythm Find invoice, credit, post, confirm details. Moments that bring you here Overbilling. Scope cut after invoice. Goodwill. Duplicate bill. ⓘ Against invoices PO is still the contract. Write-offs are a different instrument. Flowcharts flowchart TD A[Open Credit notes] --> B[Select invoice] B --> C[Amount / reason] C --> D[Post] D --> E[Invoice balance updates] 1 Open Finance → Credit notes. 2 Invoice Existing bill. 3 Post Credit document. 4 Confirm Invoice balance. Overview Credit notes adjust invoices. Write-offs abandon collectability. PO amendments change the contract. How to use 1. Always against a bill Do not credit a PO as if it were an invoice. 2. Reason codes Audit will ask. 3. Masking Customer commercials still persona-limited. Related pages Platform invoices Bills. Write-offs Uncollectible. Invoice details Lines. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

pages.title: Finance Dashboard
pages.description: Finance control tower over POs, invoices, and project financials — charts on live commercial entities, not a warehouse you type into.
headings: Money views of POs, invoices, and projects
pages.content: Finance Dashboard — Tracopus User Guide Home → Finance → Finance dashboard Commercial tower Money views of POs, invoices, and projects The finance dashboard rolls up live commercial records. It is not a general ledger you journal into. Finance → Finance dashboard Route /finance/dashboard Org flag dashboardEnabled Finance Manager · Executive · Admin The job of this console See what is off, drill into PO, invoice, or project financials, fix there, return. Seat at the table Finance managers, executives, admins. PMs use project financials. Payroll uses payroll dashboards. The working rhythm Scan, drill, correct source, refresh. Moments that bring you here Month-end. A leakage spike. Unbilled delivery. After a big PO. ⓘ Composed, not posted PurchaseOrder is the contract. Invoices bill. This tower does not replace either. Flowcharts flowchart TD A[Open Finance dashboard] --> B[Read KPIs] B --> C[Drill PO / invoice / project] C --> D[Fix source] D --> E[Tower refreshes] 1 Open Finance → Finance dashboard. 2 Scan Commercial KPIs. 3 Drill PO, invoice, project financials. 4 Fix Source register. Overview Finance dashboard composes PurchaseOrder, invoices, and project financials. Payroll readiness is a different tower. How to use 1. Drill to act Do not type a number into a chart. 2. PO is the contract Projects hang off it when the chain is used. 3. Masking Margins may be persona-limited. Related pages Purchase orders Contracts. Platform invoices Bills. Project financials Delivery $. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

pages.title: Expenses (Finance View)
pages.description: Finance operations view of employee expense claims — the same expense records employees submit, not a second petty-cash book.
pages.content: Expenses (Finance View) — Tracopus User Guide Home → Finance → Expenses (finance view) Claims ops Employee expenses, finance seat This is the finance view of the same claims employees submit. It is not vendor AP and not a petty-cash sidecar. Finance → Expenses (finance view) Route /finance/expenses Org flag expensesEnabled Finance Manager · Admin The job of this console Review, approve or bounce, send toward reimbursement. Confirm the employee still sees the same claim. Seat at the table Finance managers. Employees use Payroll → Expenses (employee). Payroll may pay via reimbursements. The working rhythm Filter pending, open, decide, watch pay path. Moments that bring you here Month-end claims. A duplicate receipt. Policy breach. After travel week. ⓘ One expense entity Two menus, one record. Vendor invoices remain supplier bills. Flowcharts flowchart TD A[Open Finance expenses] --> B[Filter claims] B --> C[Open claim] C --> D[Approve or bounce] D --> E[Employee expenses + reimbursements] 1 Open Finance → Expenses. 2 Filter Period and status. 3 Decide Same expense record. 4 Pay path Reimbursements / payroll. Overview Finance expenses is the ops seat on employee claims. Employee expenses is self-service. Vendor invoices are suppliers. How to use 1. One claim entity Two seats. 2. Receipts Sensitive — masking. 3. Not AP vendor bills Wrong register. Related pages Expenses (employee) Self-service. Reimbursements Pay-out. Vendor invoices Suppliers. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

pages.title: Project Financials
pages.description: Cost, billed, and margin on live projects and their POs — not a second project list.
headings: What this project billed against its contract
pages.content: Project Financials — Tracopus User Guide Home → Finance → Project financials Delivery money What this project billed against its contract Project financials compares PO, invoices, and delivery cost on a live Project. It is not a new contract. Finance → Project financials Route /finance/project-financials Org flag projectFinancialsEnabled Finance Manager · Executive · Admin The job of this console Open a project, see contracted vs billed vs cost, jump to the register that is wrong. Seat at the table Finance, executives, admins. PMs may see scoped projects. The working rhythm Pick project, compare, drill PO or invoice, return. Moments that bring you here Unbilled WIP. Overrun. Customer query. After timesheet lock. ⓘ Lens on the chain PurchaseOrder remains the contract. Invoices remain bills. Project remains delivery. Flowcharts flowchart TD A[Open Project financials] --> B[Select project] B --> C[PO vs billed vs cost] C --> D{Gap?} D -->|Billing| E[Invoices] D -->|Contract| F[Purchase order] D -->|Delivery| G[Project / timesheet] 1 Open Finance → Project financials. 2 Select Existing Project. 3 Compare PO, invoices, cost. 4 Fix source Do not journal here. Overview Project financials is a money lens on Project, PurchaseOrder, invoices, and time. Revenue recognition posts on its own console. How to use 1. Chain PO → Project still matters. 2. Hours Timesheet is effort source. 3. Masking Margin may hide from some personas. Related pages Purchase orders Contract. Project list Delivery. Revenue recognition Posting. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

pages.title: Revenue Forecast
pages.description: Forward look composed from POs, plans, and pipeline — a forecast view, not a second set of contracts.
headings: Forecast from contracts and pipeline you already have
pages.content: Revenue Forecast — Tracopus User Guide Home → Finance → Revenue forecast Forward look Forecast from contracts and pipeline you already have Revenue forecast looks ahead using bids, POs, and plans. It does not create a parallel contract book. Finance → Revenue forecast Route /finance/revenue-forecast Org flag revenueForecastEnabled Finance Manager · Executive · Admin The job of this console Pick a horizon, see what is driving the number, open that bid or PO if it is wrong. Seat at the table Finance and executives. Sales operators update bids; finance owns the lens. The working rhythm Set horizon, read, drill, fix source. Moments that bring you here Quarter commit. Board pack. After a slipped PO. A bid that should not be weighted. ⓘ View of commercial sources Bids are pursuit. POs are contracts. Recognition books revenue. Flowcharts flowchart TD A[Open Revenue forecast] --> B[Pick horizon] B --> C[See drivers] C --> D[Bid / PO / plan] D --> E[Forecast follows] 1 Open Finance → Revenue forecast. 2 Horizon Period. 3 Drivers Pipeline and contracts. 4 Fix source Not the chart. Overview Forecast composes bids, POs, and billing plans. Booked revenue still needs invoices/recognition per policy. How to use 1. Won ≠ recognized Recognition console posts. 2. Pipeline weighting Understand the product’s rules. 3. Do not sandbox in Excel as source Change the bid/PO. Related pages Bid requests Pipeline. Purchase orders Contracts. Revenue recognition Booked. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

pages.title: Revenue Leakage
pages.description: Unbilled, under-billed, or leaked value vs delivery and contract — a detective view, not a write-off register.
headings: Where value leaked vs the contract
1 — Find then bill or write off
pages.content: Revenue Leakage — Tracopus User Guide Home → Finance → Revenue leakage Detective view Where value leaked vs the contract Revenue leakage highlights unbilled or under-billed delivery against POs. It does not post a journal. Finance → Revenue leakage Route /finance/revenue-leakage Org flag revenueLeakageEnabled Finance Manager · Executive · Admin The job of this console Find a gap, open the project or PO, then invoice, fix time, or write off on those consoles. Seat at the table Finance and executives. PMs may be asked to explain delivery, not to post. The working rhythm Filter gaps, drill, act on invoice/write-off/timesheet, refresh. Moments that bring you here Month-end unbilled. A forgotten milestone bill. After lock. Board asking about leakage. ⓘ Finder, not a ledger Invoices bill. Write-offs forgive. Credit notes reverse. This screen points. Flowcharts flowchart TD A[Open Revenue leakage] --> B[Filter gaps] B --> C[Open project / PO] C --> D{Action} D -->|Bill| E[Invoices] D -->|Give up| F[Write-offs] D -->|Hours| G[Timesheet] 1 Open Finance → Revenue leakage. 2 Filter Unbilled variance. 3 Decide Bill, write off, or fix time. 4 Source consoles Never the chart as ledger. Overview Leakage is a finder over delivery vs billed vs contract. Write-offs and credit notes are explicit documents. How to use 1. Don’t hide leakage in a slide Invoice or write off. 2. Hours Timesheet may be the hole. 3. PO scope Out of scope is not leakage if the contract never included it. Related pages Platform invoices Bill it. Write-offs Give up. Project financials Context. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

pages.title: Revenue Recognition
pages.description: Policies, schedules, entries, and period close for recognized vs billed — composed from contracts and invoices, not a shadow GL.
headings: Recognize against contracts you already have
pages.content: Revenue Recognition — Tracopus User Guide Home → Finance → Revenue recognition Booked revenue Recognize against contracts you already have Revenue recognition posts recognized vs billed using policies and schedules on live POs and invoices. It is not a second general ledger product. Finance → Revenue recognition Route /finance/revenue-recognition Org flag revenueRecognitionEnabled Finance Manager · Admin The job of this console Keep methods true, generate period entries, approve, close. Fix the contract if the schedule is nonsense. Seat at the table Finance managers and admins. Executives read forecast/analytics, not always this hub. The working rhythm Policies → schedules → entries → period close, then dashboards follow. Moments that bring you here Month close. Milestone method change. Audit of recognized revenue. After a credit note. ⓘ Entries on commercial sources PO and invoices remain canonical. This hub posts recognition, it does not invent contracts. Flowcharts flowchart TD A[Open Revenue recognition] --> B[Policies] B --> C[Schedules] C --> D[Entries] D --> E[Period close] 1 Open Finance → Revenue recognition. 2 Policy Method catalog. 3 Entries Approve/reverse. 4 Close Period close tab. Overview Recognition is a workflow on contracts and invoices. The hub tabs (policies, schedules, entries, close) are in-page, not separate source systems. How to use 1. Billed vs recognized Invoices can lead or lag. 2. Do not Excel-post Entries live here. 3. PO still contract Methods hang off that commercial truth. Related pages Billing plans When you bill. Purchase orders Contract. Platform invoices Billed. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

pages.title: Vendor Costs
pages.description: Cost against vendors and POs — spend lens, not a second vendor master and not employee expenses.
headings: What we paid vendors, on documents we already keep
pages.content: Vendor Costs — Tracopus User Guide Home → Finance → Vendor costs Supplier spend What we paid vendors, on documents we already keep Vendor costs charts spend against vendor masters, POs, and supplier invoices. It is not a new supplier list. Finance → Vendor costs Route /finance/vendor-costs Org flag vendorCostsEnabled Finance Manager · Admin The job of this console Filter a vendor, see spend, open the PO or vendor invoice that is wrong. Seat at the table Finance managers and admins. Procurement may use POs more than this lens. The working rhythm Filter, drill document, fix, refresh. Moments that bring you here Month-end AP. A vendor duplicate. After a PO import. Accrual questions. ⓘ Lens on vendor documents Admin vendors is the master. Employee expenses are a different register. Flowcharts flowchart TD A[Open Vendor costs] --> B[Filter vendor] B --> C[See spend] C --> D[PO or vendor invoice] D --> E[Fix document] 1 Open Finance → Vendor costs. 2 Vendor Master remains Admin vendors. 3 Document PO or vendor invoice. 4 Fix Those registers. Overview Vendor costs is a spend lens. Vendor register is the master. Vendor invoices are supplier bills. Employee expenses are different. How to use 1. Master on vendors Do not rename a vendor only here. 2. PO still contract When buying via PO. 3. Not paycheck People costs are payroll. Related pages Vendor register Master. Vendor invoices Supplier bills. Purchase orders Contracts. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

pages.title: Vendor Invoices
pages.description: Supplier bills — AP documents against vendors and POs, not platform customer invoices.
pages.content: Vendor Invoices — Tracopus User Guide Home → Finance → Vendor invoices Supplier bills AP documents, not customer invoices Vendor invoices are what suppliers bill you. Platform invoices are what you bill customers. Keep them on their own registers. Finance → Vendor invoices Route /vendors/invoices Org flag vendorInvoicesEnabled Finance Manager · Admin The job of this console Capture the supplier bill against vendor and PO, move status, let vendor costs follow. Seat at the table Finance AP operators. Vendors do not log in here. The working rhythm Select vendor, link PO, enter bill, post. Moments that bring you here A PDF from a supplier. Three-way match fail. After a new vendor. Month-end AP. ⓘ Not platform invoices Customer AR is /finance/invoice. This route is /vendors/invoices. Flowcharts flowchart TD A[Open Vendor invoices] --> B[Select vendor] B --> C[Link PO if any] C --> D[Lines / status] D --> E[Vendor costs update] 1 Open Vendors → invoices / Finance vendor invoices. 2 Vendor Master row. 3 PO If the buy was contracted. 4 Post AP document. Overview Vendor invoices are AP. Platform invoices are AR/customer. Mixing them breaks reporting. How to use 1. Right register Customer bills are Finance → Platform invoices. 2. Vendor must exist Master first. 3. PO match When three-way is required. Related pages Vendor register Master. Vendor costs Spend lens. Platform invoices Customer bills — different. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

pages.title: Write-offs
pages.description: Uncollectible amounts — explicit write-off documents, not a silent edit of invoices or leakage charts.
headings: Give up on a balance on purpose
pages.content: Write-offs — Tracopus User Guide Home → Finance → Write-offs Uncollectible Give up on a balance on purpose Write-offs are explicit documents that a balance will not be collected. They are not a hidden chart edit. Finance → Write-offs Route /finance/write-offs Org flag writeOffsEnabled Finance Manager · Admin The job of this console Select the amount, record a reason, post. Confirm invoices/AR and leakage follow. Seat at the table Finance managers and admins. Executives may approve. The working rhythm Identify uncollectible, post write-off, confirm related views. Moments that bring you here Bad debt. Customer gone. After legal settle. Leakage you will not bill. ⓘ Own document Not a credit note. Not a PO change. Audit wants this register. Flowcharts flowchart TD A[Open Write-offs] --> B[Select balance] B --> C[Reason] C --> D[Post] D --> E[AR / leakage follow] 1 Open Finance → Write-offs. 2 Select Uncollectible. 3 Reason Audit trail. 4 Post Own document. Overview Write-offs abandon collection. Credits adjust customer bills. Neither replaces PO amendments. How to use 1. Explicit document Do not zero an invoice line as a fake write-off if the product wants this register. 2. Approvals Follow policy. 3. Leakage Should drop after post. Related pages Credit notes Customer credit. Revenue leakage Finder. Platform invoices Bills. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.description: Getting Started — Tracopus user guide for enterprise work intelligence.
headings: I forgot my password — what now?
Why don't I see all sidebar modules?
What's the difference between deliverable and work item?
Can I use Tracopus on my phone?
pages.content: Getting Started — Tracopus User Guide Home → Getting Started Chapter 1 Getting Started Sign in, understand the workspace layout, and learn the building blocks — projects, deliverables, work items, and timesheets — before diving into module-specific guides. Login & authentication Open the application URL provided by your administrator. You land on the Luxury login screen with brand panel on the left and credentials on the right. 1. Enter username and password Use the credentials issued by your organization. Click the eye icon to reveal your password while typing. 2. Click Sign In On success you are redirected to your default module dashboard based on permissions — Project, HRMS, or Sales. 3. Session stays active Your session persists in the browser. Use Sign out from the header account menu when leaving a shared computer. ⚠️ Shared computers Always use Sign out from the header account menu when leaving a shared workstation. Sessions persist in the browser by default. 💡 Default landing page After login you land on your role's default module — Project Dashboard, HRMS Dashboard, or Sales list. Bookmark your most-used screen from the sidebar. Microsoft Single Sign-On (SSO) When enabled, click Sign in with Microsoft on the login page. You are redirected to Microsoft, authenticate, grant consent if prompted, and return logged in automatically. 📝 SSO availability SSO is controlled by your organization. If you do not see the Microsoft button, use standard login or contact your admin. Forgot password Click Forgot Password on the login page. Enter your username or email and submit. Check your inbox for reset instructions and follow the link. Set a new password on the change-password screen. Account activation New employees receive an activation link ( /user/activateaccount/… ). Open it, set your initial password, then sign in normally. The same flow applies to forced password changes via /user/changepassword/… . Navigation overview The Luxury shell has three navigation zones: Left sidebar Module directories — HRMS, Sales, Project — each expanding to show permitted pages. Icon rail Quick links: Search, Taskboard, Calendar, Notes, Chat, Files, theme, settings, today activity. Top header Module kicker, page title, global search, tasks/chat/notifications dropdowns, account menu. See the Luxury Interface guide for full detail on search, palettes, and mobile shortcuts. Core concepts Term Meaning Project A delivery container with account, team, estimates, status, and members. Links optionally to purchase orders and bids. Deliverable A task-level outcome within a project (also called a task in some views). Has status, estimates, assignees, and work items underneath. Work item Granular unit of work and time logging tied to a deliverable — billable or non-billable activities. Account Client or organizational node in the directory — may represent accounts, teams, or clients in a hierarchy. Timesheet Weekly grid of recorded hours (billable, non-billable, leave) submitted per employee. Bid request Sales pipeline record tracking study/commercial bids from intake through won or lost. Purchase order Contract linked to delivery — may connect to bids and spawn projects. Team Organizational scope used for filtering lists, reports, and dashboards. Bid (Sales) → Purchase Order → Project → Deliverable → Work item → Timesheet Recommended first steps 1. Check your HRMS dashboard Review attendance strip, utilization donut, and task queue mix for the current week. 2. Open the Taskboard See your assigned deliverables in Planned → To do → In progress → Done columns. 3. Log time in Timesheet Navigate to HRMS → Time Sheet, pick the week, and add billable or non-billable entries. 4. Register mobile (optional) From mobile User Login, scan the QR code after web authentication to enable PIN/biometric access. 5. Personalize your theme Click the palette droplet on the icon rail and pick a color mood that suits you — it syncs to mobile. Frequently asked questions I forgot my password — what now? Use Forgot Password on the login page. If email does not arrive, check spam or contact your admin — SSO users may not use local passwords. Why don't I see all sidebar modules? Modules and pages are permission-gated. HRMS Employees, Sales, and Admin settings appear only when your role includes those scopes. What's the difference between deliverable and work item? A deliverable is a planned outcome within a project (milestone/task). Work items are granular activities underneath — where most time is logged on the timesheet. Can I use Tracopus on my phone? Yes — see Mobile overview . Register your device after web login via QR code for PIN or biometric access. ℹ️ Need deeper detail? Each screen in HRMS, Sales, Project, and Mobile has a dedicated guide with charts, features, permissions, and common mistakes — open the module index from the top navigation. Scenario user guide When you need to complete a task (not just understand a screen), open the Scenario User Guide . It documents 73 workflows across 15 modules with: Required permissions — RBAC config paths your admin must enable Org & feature flags — behavior when Application Config toggles are on or off Warnings & considerations — common failures and planning notes Numbered steps and a QA verification checklist per scenario Sign in Email/password login scenario Log timesheet Weekly hour entry Approvals inbox Approve timesheet, leave, attendance All 65 scenarios Complete workflow index Your profile Open the account menu (avatar) in the header → Profile to view your employee record, skills, security settings, notifications, and account activity. Managers can open any employee from HRMS → Employees. Settings (gear on icon rail or account menu) covers organization preferences: mobile device registration, schedulers, service health, company info, localization, and notifications. Next: Luxury Interface → © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved. Documentation Scenario Guide Getting Started Charts For support, contact your workspace administrator.

pages.content: Application Configuration — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Application Configuration Org master and access Lists, keys, and role flags — the store other screens read Application Configuration is the definitive guide to organization master data, feature toggles, and role permissions — every key with behaviour and downstream impact. The live editor is Application Config in the product; this page is the map of what those keys mean. Admin / HRMS → Application Config Route /admin/appconfig HR Admin · Org Admin The job of this console Look up a key before you change it, understand which screens will move, then edit in the live Config UI. Use search on this page to find a flag or list without wandering the left nav blind. Seat at the table Administrators. The in-app Guide lives on the Config left nav, not the hero — on purpose. Employees never edit org.json. The working rhythm Search the key, read the impact, open live Application Config, change the value, verify the downstream screen. Do not duplicate lists into a new table. Moments that bring you here A missing leave type in a dropdown. A module that will not appear. Role permission hunting. After an industry template apply. ⓘ Protected source of truth Application Config is the org source of truth. Dashboards, AI, and Work Graph must not grow shadow lists. Persona masking still applies to sensitive values. ⌕ Org Roles No matching configuration keys — try a shorter term or clear the filter. Interactive data flow simulators This page lists static flag keys from org.json and role.json. Open simulators to toggle flags live and trace table-level effects. Open hub All 8 simulators → Leave Request flow → Roles personaModules → Access Persona nav → Inbox Delegation → Overview 🏢 Application configuration org.json seeds dropdown lists, email routing, service-line trees, and boolean feature flags. Org units inherit from parent nodes; child teams override with the chain icon. Bands, departments, skills categoryMap service-line tree PO & project notification emails Persona navigation map & org kill switches 🔐 Access control role.json defines module visibility and CRUD gates. Roles attach to org units via Role Bar; users receive effective permissions on login refresh. Sidebar module toggles Persona access ( personaModules ) Timesheet edit windows Report catalog access Org node type=org — inherits parentValue until overridden. Use for team-specific department lists or regional notification emails. Role node type=role — permission template. Clone Site Admin to create Manager, Finance, or IC roles with reduced flags. Inherit chain Linked chain = use parent value. Broken chain = local override stored on this node (overridden=true). Lock & hide Lock blocks child overrides — ideal for enterprise-wide categoryMap. Hide removes from non-admin UI when combined with lock. ℹ️ Who should use this page Workspace administrators, IT ops, and implementation leads configuring Tracopus after deployment. Requires hrmsModules.appconfigEnabled on your role. Changes affect all users in the selected org scope on next config refresh. 💡 Work-Time Governance Timesheet validation, deadline preview / late reason, approval-chain, import/export, estimates, and attendance-source features are a default-off catalog. Enable them from Admin → Feature flags ; choices persist here on the HRMS module. Screen guide: Work-Time Governance . pages.title: Attendance
pages.description: Month matrix for present / absent / leave, manager approvals, regularization requests, leave-to-attendance sync, and soft payroll lock (no matrix export).
headings: Present, absent, leave — the month payroll can lock
pages.content: Attendance — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Attendance Month matrix Present, absent, leave — the month payroll can lock Attendance is the month matrix for present / absent / leave, manager approvals, regularization, leave-to-attendance sync, and a soft payroll lock. It is not a badge-swipe raw dump. People → Attendance Route /hrms/attendance Employee · Manager · HR Admin The job of this console Mark or regularize a day, approve a team matrix, and understand when a period is soft-locked for payroll. Leave already approved should sync; do not double-enter it as absence. Seat at the table Employees see self. Managers approve their team. HR sees wider scope. Payroll reads this after lock — they do not edit cells here as a ledger. The working rhythm Open the month, filter the team, regularize or approve, confirm leave sync, then treat lock as the freeze before pay. Use shift policies for working-week context. Moments that bring you here Missed punch. A leave day that did not flow into the matrix. Month-end before payroll. After a holiday calendar change. ⓘ Protected production flow Approvals and lock behave as the live attendance engine. This how-to explains the screen; it does not replace the matrix as source. Interactive data flow Toggle attendance flags — mark, auto-approve, manager queue, regularization bridge, and leave sync. Primary simulator Attendance & regularization → All simulators Flowcharts Each diagram auto-plays steps when it scrolls into view. Use Play / Pause , or click a step. Matching nodes highlight as the narration advances. flowchart TD A[Enable attendance role] --> B[Shift / holiday config] B --> C[Regularization policy optional] C --> D[Mark matrix] D --> E[Approve pending] E --> F[Soft payroll lock] 1 Enable attendance role Role flag attendanceEnabled + mark/approve permissions. 2 Shift / holiday config Optional shift policies and People holidays for correct day context. 3 Regularization policy Turn on when employees can request corrections; set soft payroll lock day when used. 4 Mark matrix Managers mark present/absent/leave per employee-day. 5 Approve pending Clear attendance and regularization queues. 6 Soft payroll lock May freeze prior-month edits / regularizations after the lock day — no matrix export in product today. flowchart TD O[Open Attendance] --> F[Filter team / employee / month] F --> C[Click day cell] C --> M[Mark popover] M --> S{Status} S -->|Present / Absent / Half-day / Leave| Save[Save mark] Save --> Aud[Audit event] Save --> Pend{Needs approval?} Pend -->|Yes| Queue[Pending approvals] Pend -->|No| Done[Visible on matrix] 1 Open Attendance HRMS → Attendance with team access. 2 Filter Narrow team, employee, and month before marking. 3 Click day cell Open mark or details popover for that employee-day. 4 Mark popover Choose status and save. 5 Status Present, absent, half-day, leave, etc. per org options. 6 Save mark Persists the attendance record. 7 Audit event Who changed what is recorded when audit is on. 8 Needs approval? Some orgs route marks to a pending queue. 9 Pending approvals Manager decides later. 10 Visible on matrix Cell color updates immediately when no approval needed. flowchart TD Emp[Employee or manager] --> Reg[Submit regularization] Reg --> Pol{Policy / payroll lock OK?} Pol -->|No| Block[Blocked with reason] Pol -->|Yes| Sub[SUBMITTED] Sub --> Mgr[Manager / delegate decides] Mgr -->|Approve| Upd[Attendance updated] Mgr -->|Reject| Rel[Rejected + comment] 1 Requester Employee (self-service) or manager on their behalf. 2 Submit regularization Pick date, reason, and requested status. 3 Policy / lock check Fails closed if outside policy or past payroll lock. 4 Blocked User sees why the request cannot proceed. 5 SUBMITTED Enters pending regularization queue. 6 Manager decides Approve or reject with comment. 7 Attendance updated Matrix reflects the approved correction. 8 Rejected No matrix change; requester notified. flowchart TD L[Leave approved] --> Flag{leaveAutoSyncToAttendance?} Flag -->|Yes| Sync[Write LEAVE / HALF_DAY] Sync --> Mat[Shows on Attendance matrix] Flag -->|No| Manual[Manual mark or leave overlay only] 1 Leave approved Manager approves a leave request. 2 Sync flag? Org leaveAdditional.leaveAutoSyncToAttendance. 3 Write LEAVE / HALF_DAY Attendance sync service updates working days in range. 4 Shows on matrix Cells display leave without manual mark. 5 Manual path If flag off, mark leave cells yourself or rely on overlay only. flowchart TD P[Pending panel or Approvals inbox] --> Rev[Review employee-day] Rev --> Dec{Decision} Dec -->|Approve| Acc[Accept mark / regularization] Acc --> Mat[Matrix updated] Dec -->|Reject| Com[Reject + comment] 1 Open pending Attendance page pending section or Approvals inbox. 2 Review Check employee, date, requested status, and reason. 3 Decision Approve or reject. 4 Accept Mark or regularization becomes final. 5 Matrix updated Cell reflects the approved status. 6 Reject + comment No change to attendance; requester notified. Overview HRMS → Attendance is the month-at-a-glance control surface for who was present, absent, on leave, or needs correction. Managers mark cells, approve pending items, and (when enabled) process regularization. Approved leave can auto-write attendance when leaveAutoSyncToAttendance is on. Work-Time Governance can ingest swipe evidence and compose a read-only source (leave → swipe → timesheet WFH → regularization). That compose API does not write this matrix and does not invent entry/exit times from hours-only timesheets. attendance.period-lock is catalogued but has no lock service yet — do not accept it as active. A complete ACS / device feed still needs the client vendor API; overnight pairing is limited, not full shift windows. Screen layout Header — team scope, employee filter, Documentation link, month navigation via summary. Summary strip — attendance rate and absence KPIs for the filtered month. Pending approvals — attendance marks / regularizations awaiting decision. Matrix — employees × days; color-coded cells; click to mark or view details. Current-user panel — your own pattern when viewing self. Payroll lock banner — soft lock when prior-month edits are frozen (no matrix export). Flags & prerequisites Role: hrmsModules.attendanceEnabled + attendance CRUD as needed. Org: attendanceAdditional.attendanceRegularizationEnabled for regularization flows. Org: leaveAdditional.leaveAutoSyncToAttendance for leave → attendance writes. Work-Time catalog (Feature Flags): attendance.swipe-ingest , attendance.source-resolution , attendance.timesheet-wfh , attendance.cross-midnight — all default off until enabled. Do not rely on attendance.period-lock — no lock service is shipped for that flag. Optional: shift policies ( /admin/shift-policies ), holidays ( Leave Configuration → Holidays ), delegation for approvers away. Feature & use-case map Use case Who What happens View month matrix Manager / HR Filter team/employee; navigate months Mark present/absent Manager / HR Cell popover saves status (+ audit) Approve attendance Manager / delegate Pending panel or Approvals inbox Submit regularization Employee / manager Request exception; policy + lock checked Approve regularization Manager / HR Attendance updated on approve Leave sync System Approved leave writes LEAVE / HALF_DAY when flagged Payroll lock Policy Soft lock may block prior-month regularizations / edits after lock day (no matrix export) Complete feature list ✓ Month matrix Employees × days with present/absent/leave markers. ✓ Cell mark / details Popover to mark or inspect history for one employee-day. ✓ Pending approvals Attendance and regularization queues. ✓ Regularization Exception requests with policy gates and soft payroll lock. ✓ Leave sync Approved leave can auto-mark attendance. ✓ Intelligence / anomalies Optional anomaly and recommendation panels when enhancements are on. ✓ Audit panel Marks, edits, approvals on attendance records. pages.title: Unified Audit Trail
pages.description: A single luxury timeline for meaningful actions — who did what, when, and on which record — across projects, HR, and profile activity.
headings: Meaningful actions across projects, HR, and profile
pages.content: Unified Audit Trail — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Unified Audit Trail Unified timeline Meaningful actions across projects, HR, and profile The unified audit trail is a luxury timeline for meaningful actions — who did what, when, on which record — across projects, HR, and profile activity. It is a reading surface on events the product already writes. Docs · Unified audit (related to Admin audit) HR Admin · Manager (scoped) · Admin The job of this console Follow a person’s or record’s story when something looks wrong. Filter, open the owning record, correct it there. Org-wide compliance investigation still prefers Admin audit. Seat at the table Administrators and managers with scope. Employees may see their own account activity on profile. Masking still applies. The working rhythm Pick a window and actor, read the timeline, jump to the record, fix at source. Moments that bring you here A profile field changed overnight. A project update nobody remembers. After a support ticket. When Admin audit is too wide and you need a human timeline. ⓘ Events, not a writable log You cannot edit history here. Sensitive snippets stay masked when persona policy says so. Overview The unified audit system records events when users (or delegates) perform tracked actions. Events appear in Audit tabs on project, purchase contract, deliverable, work item, profile, attendance, timesheet, and leave screens. Legacy @History and ItemAdditional HISTORY feeds are not shown in the new UI. History starts from go-live when your administrator enables audit writes. Where to find audit Profile → Account activity — actor timeline + entity filter Project / PO / Deliverable — Comments | Audit tabs Work item — activity register audit mode Attendance — audit feed with deep links to day cells Timesheet week — submit/approve/lock events Leave drawer — request lifecycle with redaction What is tracked Project, PO, deliverable, work item lifecycle Comments, checklist updates, estimates Employee profile and role changes Attendance mark, approve, reject, removal Leave submit, approve, reject, withdraw Timesheet submit, approve, reject, lock Login and password change (security) Timeline UI Each event shows headline , actor , timestamp , action chip (Approved, Submitted, etc.), and optional metadata (status change, acting-for manager, approval comment). Pagination uses server-side pageInfo.hasMore — use prev/next at the bottom of the trail. Delegate actions display Acting for {name} when metadata includes acting-for fields. Access & privacy Scope Who can view Actor timeline Self, direct manager, or approval delegate (attendance/timesheet/leave). Employee / HR entity Same rules on the subject employee. Project / PO / deliverable Users on the same org team as the resource. Leave metadata Reason and remarks redacted for non-self viewers. What's new ✓ Luxury timeline Shared AuditTrailSection component across modules. ✓ Actor + entity queries Filter profile activity by entity type (attendance, leave, etc.). ✓ Attendance deep links Jump from audit event to attendance detail popover. ✓ CSV export Compliance export with same permission checks (admin). ✓ Fail-safe writes Audit DB errors never fail leave approve, timesheet submit, or project save. ✓ Dedup Duplicate events suppressed via natural key — safe retries. Administrator setup ℹ️ Enable writes Set auditEnabled: true per org after DB migration. UI can show with auditUiEnabled: true (default). 💡 Empty timeline? Events appear only after enablement — perform a tracked action to verify. Related pages Employee Profile Account activity actor timeline. Project Details Activity tab Audit panel. Leave Management Leave audit drawer. Timesheet Approval Week workflow events. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

pages.title: Employee Dashboard
pages.description: Two-tab dashboard: My dashboard for individuals and Team dashboard for managers with org-wide workforce analytics.
headings: My numbers, then the team’s — still the same employees
pages.content: Employee Dashboard — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Employee Dashboard Two-tab people tower My numbers, then the team’s — still the same employees The employee dashboard has two tabs: My dashboard for individuals and Team dashboard for managers with workforce analytics. Both read live Employee, leave, attendance, and timesheet — they do not keep a second headcount. People → HR dashboard Route /hrms/dashboard Employee (self) · Manager / HR (team) The job of this console See personal time and leave posture, or switch to team analytics when you manage people. Drill into leave, timesheet, or the directory rather than treating a chart as editable. Seat at the table Every employee gets My dashboard. Team dashboard is for managers, HR, and executives whose persona can open it. Admin towers stay under Admin. The working rhythm Open People dashboard, read the active tab, follow a card into the owning register, act there, return. Managers switch tab instead of opening a different product. Moments that bring you here Monday personal scan. A manager preparing 1:1s. HR looking at team leave load. Not for payroll totals — that is Payroll and Finance. ⓘ Charts are views of HRMS sources Headcount, leave, and hours come from Employee, leave, attendance, and timesheet. Correct the source screen if a number looks wrong. Flowcharts Each diagram auto-plays when it scrolls into view. Use Play / Pause or click a step. flowchart TD Open[Open Dashboard] --> Tab{Tab} Tab -->|My| Pers[Personal KPIs] Tab -->|Team| Mgr[Team analytics] Mgr --> Scope[Team scope filter] 1 Open Dashboard HRMS → Dashboard. 2 Tab My or Team (managers). 3 Personal KPIs Attendance, utilization, trends. 4 Team analytics Headcount and workforce charts. 5 Team scope filter Narrow org unit on Team tab. flowchart TD R[Refresh] --> Load[Reload insights] Load --> Cards[Update panels] 1 Refresh Header Refresh on My tab. 2 Reload insights Fetches utilization and attendance. 3 Update panels Charts and KPI tiles refresh. Overview HRMS → Dashboard is the default landing for many HRMS users. headings: The calendar leave counting actually uses
pages.content: Holidays — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Holidays Public and company days The calendar leave counting actually uses Holidays maintains public and company holidays by location so leave day counts and calendars stay accurate. A missing holiday is how a ‘working Friday’ gets billed as leave. People → Holidays Route /people/holidays Org flag holidaysEnabled HR Admin · Admin The job of this console Keep location calendars true: add a public holiday, add a company shutdown, retire a date that was wrong. Legal calendars and working-week rules still live under Leave admin; this is the holiday list those engines read. Seat at the table HR administrators. Employees see holidays on leave and timesheet UIs; they do not edit the list. The working rhythm Pick a location, add or edit a date, save, then preview a leave request that spans it. Import via legal calendars when the org uses operator-assisted import. Moments that bring you here Diwali / Thanksgiving week. A new location. A gazetted holiday announced late. After leave counts looked a day high. ⓘ Holidays feed leave and attendance Do not maintain a parallel holiday spreadsheet. Legal calendar import still lands here for the dates people see. Flowcharts Each diagram auto-plays steps when it scrolls into view. Use Play / Pause , or click a step to jump. flowchart TD A[Open Holidays] --> B[Add or bulk import] B --> C[Set location key] C --> D[Saved calendar] D --> E[Leave day count excludes] 1 Open Holidays People → Holidays (or Admin holidays route). 2 Add or bulk import Create one row or paste/import a year of holidays. 3 Set location key Use keys like IN-KA that match jurisdiction calendar maps. 4 Saved calendar Holidays appear in year/month views by location. 5 Leave day count excludes Working-day resolver subtracts matching holidays. flowchart TD H[Holiday location key] --> M[GLP holiday mapper] M --> J[Jurisdiction] J --> Emp[Employee jurisdiction] Emp --> Days[Leave numberOfDays] 1 Holiday location key Set on each holiday (e.g. IN-KA). 2 GLP holiday mapper Assign calendar key per jurisdiction in Policy Center. 3 Jurisdiction Employee is assigned to a leave jurisdiction. 4 Leave numberOfDays Count excludes holidays for that calendar. Overview People → Holidays is the source calendar for non-working public days. Leave Configuration maps jurisdiction → calendar key so day counts stay correct across regions. How to use 1. Create holidays for the year Add national and regional days with consistent location keys. 2. Map in Policy Center Assign calendar keys under Calendars in Global Leave Policy Center. 3. Assign employees Ensure employees have jurisdiction (or working-day overrides) as needed. 4. Spot-check leave apply Apply leave across a holiday and confirm the day is excluded. pages.content: Leave Approval Scenarios — Coverage Map Tracopus · HRMS · Leave · CFA-LEAVE-WA0 Leave approval scenarios Coverage map for the native leave lifecycle behind leaveManagementEnabled : create → submit → approve / reject / withdraw / cancel, plus overlap, half-day, delegation, on-behalf, and ZingHR SYNCED coexistence. Side effects include balance ledger, Approvals inbox, attendance sync, and TaskActivity LEAVE promotion. 22 core LS scenarios 20 unit Pass (WA1+WA2) 0 Watch (P5 FE harness Pass; data optional) 0 WA2 residual core WA0–WA2: Lifecycle + cancel family + delegation / on-behalf / Zing SYNCED cancel restore are unit-gated. Product CFA waves (fiscal, MAT/PAT, comp-off, floating PH) stay Missing until W0–W4. Canonical plan: fui/docs/leave/pending/CFA_LEAVE_GAP_PLAN.md . Happy path (status → side effects) 1 Create draft CREATED. Holiday-aware day count; optional half-day on single calendar day. No pending hold. 2 Submit SUBMITTED; reserve pending balance; notify manager / delegates. Appears on Leave pending + Approvals inbox. 3a Approve APPROVED; debit (releases hold); promote TaskActivity LEAVE; attendance LEAVE / HALF_DAY when sync on. 3b Reject REJECTED; release hold; no TaskActivity / attendance write. Comment required. 4 Withdraw (owner) CREATED or SUBMITTED → WITHDRAWN; release hold if submitted. Blocked on APPROVED / SYNCED. 5 Cancel (owner) SUBMITTED / APPROVED / SYNCED → CANCELLED; release hold or creditOnCancelAfterApprove; demote TaskActivity; reverse attendance. Core scenarios (LS1–LS12) LS1 Create → Submit → Approve Pass Happy path: balance debit, promote, pending cleared. Actors Employee → Manager Assert APPROVED; debitOnApprove; promote; audit APPROVE JUnit ls1_approve_promotesAndDebitsBalance Watch Approvals inbox + attendance LEAVE cell (Playwright) LS2 Create → Submit → Reject Pass Reject releases pending; no promote / debit. Actors Employee → Manager JUnit ls2_reject_releasesPendingBalance LS3 Create → Withdraw Pass Owner withdraws draft; never pending. JUnit ls3_withdraw_draft_setsWithdrawn LS4 Submit → Withdraw Pass Owner withdraws submitted; hold released. JUnit ls4_withdraw_submitted_releasesHold LS5 Submit → Cancel Pass Owner cancels submitted; hold released; no approve-debit reverse. JUnit ls5_cancel_submitted_releasesHold LS6 Approve → Cancel Pass Owner cancel after approve credits debit and re-runs promote (demote path). JUnit ls6_cancel_afterApprove_creditsDebit LS7 Re-apply after terminal Pass Overlap ignores REJECTED / WITHDRAWN / CANCELLED; second leave can approve. Code LeaveOverlapService terminal filter JUnit ls7_overlap_ignoresTerminalStatuses LS8 Overlap block Pass Second active overlap blocked; first untouched. JUnit ls8_submit_blockedWhenOverlap LS9 Holiday / weekly-off day count Pass Create/submit resolve day count via holiday validation; non-working-only range blocked. JUnit ls9_submit_blockedWhenOnlyNonWorkingDays + day-count resolve on create/submit LS9b Half-day leave apply → approve Pass Half-day flag persisted on single-day create; multi-day request clears half-day. JUnit ls9b_create_halfDay_persistsOnSingleDay Watch Attendance HALF_DAY cell when sync on (integration) LS10 Insufficient balance Pass Submit blocked; no orphan reserve. JUnit ls10_submit_blockedWhenInsufficientBalance LS11 Illegal transitions Pass 4xx; status unchanged — withdraw on APPROVED, cancel on CREATED, approve without authority. JUnit ls11_* family LS12 Stale expectedStatus Pass Concurrent safe conflict on approve. JUnit ls12_approve_staleExpectedStatusReturnsConflict Cancel family (LS6b–d) LS6b SYNCED → Cancel Pass Same reverse as approved (credit + promote demote). JUnit ls6b_cancel_synced_creditsDebit LS6c Cancel vs Withdraw rules Pass Withdraw blocked on APPROVED/SYNCED; cancel blocked on CREATED/REJECTED/WITHDRAWN/CANCELLED. JUnit ls6c_* LS6d Non-owner cancel / withdraw Pass Manager/delegate forbidden; manager uses reject. JUnit ls6d_nonOwner_cancelAndWithdrawForbidden Delegation / on-behalf / Zing LS-DEL-1 Delegate approves Pass LEAVE delegation → delegate approves; DELEGATE + actedOnBehalfOf audit. JUnit lsDel1_approve_allowedForDelegate Wave WA2 LS-DEL-2 Expired / revoked mid-pending Pass Delegate blocked; owner manager can still approve. JUnit lsDel2_* + ApprovalAuthorityServiceTest.lsDel2_* LS-DEL-3 Attendance auto ≠ leave auto Pass ATTENDANCE-only delegation / persona cannot leave-approve; no debit/promote. JUnit lsDel3_* + authority ATTENDANCE-only vs LEAVE LS-OB-1..2 On-behalf apply / sibling isolation Pass Manager create/submit for member (member balance); approve A leaves B SUBMITTED. JUnit lsOb1_* , lsOb2_* FE buildLeaveCreatePayload(..., actorId) current user as actor LS-ZING-1 ZingHR SYNCED coexistence Pass Native leave with zinghrTransactionId + SYNCED; cancel credits balance + promote demote. JUnit lsZing1_syncedLinkedLeave_cancelCreditsBalance Side-effect checklist Effect Approve Reject / Withdraw (pre-approve) Cancel (post-approve / SYNCED) Status APPROVED REJECTED / WITHDRAWN CANCELLED Balance Debit Release hold / no debit Credit back Pending + Approvals inbox Cleared Cleared N/A Attendance (sync on) LEAVE / HALF_DAY Unchanged Reversed TaskActivity Upsert LEAVE None Demoted (deleted) Audit Actor + authority Actor CANCEL Siblings Untouched Untouched Untouched On approve — promote LeavePromotionService.promote upserts TaskActivity TaskType.LEAVE , then LeaveAttendanceSyncService.syncAfterPromotion . pages.content: Leave Configuration — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Leave Configuration Policy center Enable, publish, assign, then prove leave Leave configuration is the administrator path: enable leave, publish policies, map holidays and working weeks, assign employee balances and jurisdictions, then prove a sample request. Runtime apply stays on Leave management. Admin → Leave admin (Global Policy Center) Route /admin/leave/global-policy-center Org flag leaveManagementEnabled HR Admin · Org Admin The job of this console Stand up the engine so employees can apply. Publish policies, attach calendars, assign balances, run a proof request. Test lab and legal calendars are siblings, not replacements. Seat at the table HR administrators. Employees never publish policy. Managers do not edit global rules from My Approvals. The working rhythm Open Global Policy Center, create or edit a policy, map holidays and working week, assign people, prove with a test application, then tell the org it is live. Moments that bring you here First leave go-live. A new jurisdiction. Balance import. After a failed proof request. When classic Types & policies is hidden because Global is on. ⓘ Protected leave engine This how-to does not replace Global Policy Center, balances, or approval. Employee leave config still assigns what people hold. One-stop leave guide End-to-end configure → dry-run balances → schedulers → apply/approve, plus a Data Flow & Technical Debug tab — single HTML for HR and support. Start here Open Leave One-Stop Guide → Policies catalogue Leave Policies User Guide → Configure How to configure policies → Leave Management (runtime) Interactive data flow Trace GLP publish, balance ledger, accrual schedulers, and working-day resolver chain used before employees apply leave. Primary simulator Leave policy & accrual → Working days Shift + holidays WDR → All simulators Flowcharts Each diagram auto-plays steps when it scrolls into view. Use Play / Pause , or click a step. Matching nodes highlight as the narration advances. flowchart TD A[Enable flags] --> B[Publish policy] B --> C[Holidays and working days] C --> D[Balances / jurisdiction] D --> E[Employee applies] E --> F[Manager approves] F --> G[Attendance and timesheet] 1 Enable flags Turn on leaveManagementEnabled (and Global Leave role modules) in Application Config. 2 Publish policy Jurisdiction → template → draft → simulate → publish in Global Policy Center. 3 Holidays and working days Assign holiday calendar keys and weekly-off rules (team / country / employee). 4 Balances / jurisdiction Employee leave config: OB template → dry-run import or Adjust balance; assign jurisdictions when needed. 5 Employee applies Leave Management apply drawer with resolved day count. 6 Manager approves Pending panel or Approvals inbox. 7 Attendance and timesheet Promotion + optional leave→attendance sync. flowchart TD F1[1. App Config flags] --> F2[2. Create jurisdiction] F2 --> F3[3. Template to draft policy] F3 --> F4[4. Simulate / Policy Test Lab] F4 --> F5[5. Publish version] F5 --> F6[6. People holidays + calendar key] F6 --> F7[7. Working-day rules] F7 --> F8[8. Opening balances or accrual] F8 --> F9[9. Prove apply and approve] 1 App Config flags Org leaveAdditional + role leave/admin modules. 2 Create jurisdiction e.g. IN, IN-KA, AE — used for resolve and calendars. 3 Template → draft Apply country baseline; edit entitlements/accrual. 4 Simulate / Test Lab Dry-run for a sample employee; pass publish gates. 5 Publish version Activates accrual and eligibility. 6 Holidays + key People holidays with location keys assigned to jurisdictions. 7 Working-day rules Team default and/or country patterns; employee assigns. 8 Balances Admin → Employee leave config: Download OB template → fill → dry-run → live, or Adjust balance per employee. 9 Prove Apply leave spanning holiday/weekly off → approve → check timesheet. flowchart TD J[Jurisdiction] --> T[Template] T --> D[Draft version] D --> S[Simulate] S --> P[Publish] P --> R[Accrual and eligibility] 1 Jurisdiction Country/region dimension for the policy. 2 Template Seed draft from a national/regional baseline. 3 Draft version Edit types, accrual, carry-forward while unpublished. 4 Simulate Preview resolve for an employee before publish. 5 Publish Locks the version for runtime use. 6 Accrual and eligibility Jobs and leave apply use the published rules. flowchart TD L[Leave create or submit] --> R[LeaveWorkingDayResolver] R --> O{Employee WDR override?} O -->|Yes| P[Resolved workdays] O -->|No| J{Employee jurisdiction?} J -->|Yes| JW[Jurisdiction / country WDR] JW --> P J -->|No| TW[Team-default WDR] TW -->|Hit| P TW -->|Miss| FB[Work schedule / shift / Mon-Fri] FB --> P 1 Leave create/submit Day count always re-resolved with employeeId. 2 Resolver Shared service for leave UI, validate, promote. 3 Employee override? Personal WDR assignment — highest priority. 4 Resolved workdays Final ISO weekday set used for counting. 5 Employee jurisdiction? Assigned leave jurisdiction (country/region). 6 Jurisdiction WDR e.g. AE Sun–Thu or IN Mon–Fri. 7 Team-default WDR Rule with no jurisdiction_id. 8 Hit Use team rule workdays. 9 Fallback Work schedule → shift → Mon–Fri default. flowchart TD AP[Published policy] --> AJ[Accrual job] AJ --> BL1[Balance ledger credit] HR[HR adjust / import] --> BL2[Balance ledger] BL1 --> UI[Visible on Leave Management] BL2 --> UI 1 Published policy Entitlements/accrual rules must be live. 2 Accrual job Scheduler credits by period (idempotent). 3 Ledger credit Available balance increases. 4 HR adjust / import Employee leave config: single Adjust balance, or CSV template + dry-run import API. 5 Balance ledger Same ledger used by apply/approve. 6 Visible on Leave Management Balance cards refresh for the employee. flowchart TD A[Apply] --> V[Overlap + working days] V --> S[Submit / reserve] S --> D{Approve or Reject?} D -->|Approve| B[Debit balance] B --> P[Promote TaskActivity] P --> T[Attendance sync if flagged] D -->|Reject| Rel[Release pending + comment] 1 Apply Employee creates the leave request. 2 Validate Overlap + working-day rules + day count. 3 Submit / reserve Pending balance held. 4 Decision Approve or reject. 5 Debit Used balance increases on approve. 6 Promote Timesheet leave activities. 7 Attendance sync Optional LEAVE / HALF_DAY marks. 8 Reject path Comment required; pending released. Overview Leave has two halves: configure once (this page) and use every day ( Leave Management ). Complete the configuration layers below before asking employees to apply. pages.content: Leave Management — One-Stop Guide — Tracopus Home → HRMS → Leave Management One-Stop Guide Configure through approve One spine from flags to a decision, plus a debug tab The one-stop leave guide walks configure, assign, schedule, apply, and approve — with a technical data-flow tab for debugging — built from the live leave engine, not a parallel product story. Docs · One-stop leave (linked from leave how-tos) Route /people/leaves HR Admin · Manager · support engineer The job of this console Follow the user-guide tab to stand up leave the first time, then use the data-flow tab when a balance or flag does not match what you published. Seat at the table HR and support. Employees should use Leave management how-to for apply/approve only. The working rhythm Walk sections in order on the guide tab. Switch to data-flow when an accrual job, flag, or approval path misbehaves. Deep-dive pages still own legal calendars, documents, and test lab. Moments that bring you here Greenfield leave. A production incident on balances. Training. After enabling Global Policy Center over classic types. ⓘ Live engine, two tabs The debug tab does not write data. Accrual jobs, ApprovalAuthority, and Policy Center remain the writers. User Guide — Configure & Use Data Flow & Technical Debug Tip: use the chips above to jump. Printing this page includes both tabs. 1. How to open leave for the first time ℹ️ Two doors Employees / managers use People → Leave management ( /people/leaves ). HR admins configure first under Admin → Leave admin and Admin → Employee leave config . If the menu is missing, flags or role modules are off (see §3). Employee / manager path Sign in Use an account on a team where leave is enabled. Open People → Leave management Direct URL: /people/leaves (legacy /hrms/leaves redirects here). Confirm balances appear Balance cards show PL/CL/SL (and specials). Empty cards usually mean opening balances were never imported and accrual has not run yet — not a UI bug. Apply Use Apply leave / create drawer: pick type, dates, half-day if needed, notes/docs, then submit. Admin first-time path (before anyone applies) Application Config — turn on org + role leave flags (§3). Global Policy Center — publish a policy (§4–5). Holidays + working-day rules (§8). Employee leave config — dry-run OB import, then live (§9–10). Enable schedulers ACCRUAL / CF / COMP_OFF_EXPIRE (§11). Prove apply → approve on a test employee (§12–13). 2. Big picture — configure then use flowchart LR A[App Config flags] --> B[Publish policy] B --> C[Holidays + working days] C --> D[Opening balances / accrual] D --> E[Employee applies] E --> F[Manager / delegate approves] F --> G[Balance debit + timesheet + attendance] 💡 Publishing ≠ balances Publishing a policy activates eligibility and accrual rules. Tracopus does not invent opening balances. HR must import (or Adjust) balances, or wait for the monthly accrual job after go-live. 3. What must be configured (flags) Path: Admin → Application configuration → select the org unit / team → HRMS / Modules / role templates. Org flags ( leaveAdditional ) Flag Purpose Typical go-live leaveManagementEnabled Master switch — APIs and jobs fail closed when off Required globalLeavePoliciesEnabled Global Policy Center runtime Required (preferred) leaveEnhancementsEnabled Extended leave UX (impact drawer, etc.) Optional leaveAutoSyncToAttendance Approved leave → attendance LEAVE / HALF_DAY Usually on leaveBlockNonWorkingDayLeave Reject ranges with no working days Usually on leaveBlockOverlapRegardlessOfType Reject overlapping leave dates Usually on leaveAllowNegativeBalance Allow submit below available balance Usually off approvalDelegation.approvalDelegationEnabled Delegates can approve leave As needed Role modules peopleModules.leavesEnabled — shows People → Leave management peopleModules.holidaysEnabled — People → Holidays adminModules.leavePoliciesEnabled — classic policies + Employee leave config adminModules.globalLeavePoliciesEnabled — Global Policy Center, Test Lab, legal calendars, working-day rules Manager: approveTeamEnabled — required for approve actions Optional: universalApprovalInboxEnabled — leave in /workspace/approvals Menu rule: UI needs org leaveManagementEnabled and role peopleModules.leavesEnabled . APIs gate on the org flag only. 4. What to update — admin screen map What you update Where Route Type entitlements, accrual, CF, specials Global Policy Center → policy version /admin/leave/global-policy-center Leave type catalog (classic fallback) Leave policies /admin/leave-policies Per-employee balances / OB import Employee leave config /admin/employee-leave-config Official holidays Legal calendars + People holidays /admin/leave/legal-calendars , /people/holidays Weekly offs Working day rules /admin/leave/working-day-rules Pre-publish dry-run scenarios Policy Test Lab / Simulator /admin/leave/policy-test-lab Approval coverage when manager away Delegation /admin/delegation Org / role flags Application Config /admin/application-config 5. How to create / publish a new leave policy Primary console: Admin → Leave admin → Global Policy Center . Create or select a jurisdiction Examples: IN , IN-KA , IN-MH , AE . Used for resolve, holiday calendars, and working-day scope. Apply a country / CFA template into a draft Choose CFA-IN-KA , CFA-IN-MH , CFA-IN-HR , CFA-IN-TN-CBE , or a blank draft. Edit entitlements, accrual, carry-forward, and special-leave JSON while unpublished. Simulate / Policy Test Lab Dry-run resolve for a sample employee. Lab scenarios may gate publish. Open /admin/leave/policy-test-lab . Assign holiday calendar key Key must match People → Holidays location keys (e.g. IN-KA ). Configure working-day rules Team default, jurisdiction pattern (e.g. Mon–Fri or Sun–Thu), or employee override. Publish the version Published versions are immutable . To change rules later, clone a new draft and publish again. Publish activates accrual eligibility — it does not create balances. flowchart TD J[Jurisdiction] --> T[Apply template] T --> D[Edit draft version] D --> S[Simulate / Test Lab] S --> H[Holiday key + WDR] H --> P[Publish] P --> R[Accrual + eligibility live] APIs (for automation / support): jurisdictions POST /api/v2/leave/global/jurisdictions · apply template POST /api/v2/leave/global/templates/{id}/apply · simulate POST /api/v2/leave/global/simulate · publish POST /api/v2/leave/global/versions/{versionId}/publish . 6. Supported leave policies — how each is configured PL means Privilege Leave (earned) — not paternity. Paternity is PATERNITY . Code Name How to configure Key runtime rules Status PL Privilege Leave GLP version entitlements + monthly accrual; CF max in rules Fiscal Apr–Mar; CF max 45 ; excess LAPSE (or ENCASH if re-published) Shipped CL Casual Leave Location pack entitlements (MH/HR/TN); no CF Lapses at fiscal year end; not in KA pack Shipped SL Sick Leave Location pack (KA/HR/TN); document rules for medical proof Medical certificate when ≥3 days; no CF Shipped MATERNITY Maternity specialLeave[] in published GLP; FE child # maps days Female; min 80 service days; 182/182/84/84; proof; auto end from start Shipped PATERNITY Paternity Special leave rules in GLP Male; 5 consecutive days; window 7 days before or 45 after event Shipped MSL Milestone Leave Tenure grant rules in GLP Grant at 5/10/15/20y; 5-day block; partial use forfeits remainder Shipped WWL Wellness Leave KA female special in CFA-IN-KA 1 day/month; ±3 day apply window; lapses last working day of month Shipped COMPOFF Compensatory Off Comp-off policy + attendance credit coupling Weekend/statutory ≥6h or weekday >15h; expire 90 days Shipped FLOATING Floating Holiday Floating catalogue + calendar-year budget Employee picks published option; Jan renew credits entitlement Shipped UNPAID / UL Unpaid / LOP Catalog type; LOP coupling where enabled No entitlement balance required in typical setups Shipped ADOPTION / MISCARRIAGE Special stubs Catalog only until HR confirms days Entitleme

pages.content: Leave Policies User Guide — Tracopus Documentation Home → HRMS → Leave Policies Guide Policy catalog reading What the engine can express, and how CFA maps in The leave policies user guide is the reading room for supported policies, Global Policy Center configuration, go-live scenarios, and how new CFA requirements map to existing types — not a second policy editor. Docs · Leave policies (opens from Leave admin Guide) Route /admin/leave/global-policy-center HR Admin · implementation partner The job of this console Match a business rule to a supported policy shape before you click Publish. Use go-live scenarios as rehearsal, then configure in Policy Center. Seat at the table People designing leave. Employees read balances on Leave management, not this guide. The working rhythm Find the policy family, read the mapping, configure in Global Policy Center, prove in Test lab or a sample apply. Moments that bring you here A statutory type you have not used. CFA / compliance mapping. Training a new HR admin. Before cloning a policy that is already the wrong shape. ⓘ Guide, then Policy Center Nothing here publishes. The live policy list remains in Global Policy Center. Overview Supported policies India packs How to configure Scenarios New vs existing Admin screens Checklist What this guide covers Tracopus leave has two layers: Policy configuration — jurisdictions, country templates, versioned team policies, holidays, working days, publish (this guide + Leave Configuration ). Day-to-day runtime — employees apply on People → Leave management ; managers approve there or in Workspace → Approvals. Shipped — India CFA packs Shipped — apply / approve / accrual / CF Partial — AE / SA / US stubs Planned — adoption days TBD ℹ️ Publishing ≠ balances Publishing a policy activates eligibility and accrual rules. Opening balances still come from Employee leave config (OB template → dry-run → live) or the accrual schedule — Tracopus does not invent balances. Domain principles Location-driven policy — entitlements differ by work location / jurisdiction (KA, MH, HR, TN-CBE, …). Two leave years — earned leave uses fiscal Apr–Mar ; floating holiday budget uses calendar Jan–Dec . Leave always needs approval — even when attendance auto-approves for some bands. Configurable, not hardcoded — rules live in Global Leave templates / published versions (not hard-coded Sat/Sun). Canonical sources only — Employee, leave types, balance ledger, holidays, TaskActivity promotion; no shadow leave tables. Quick path (first go-live) Flags — enable leaveManagementEnabled (+ Global Leave role modules) in Application Config. Publish policy — Global Policy Center: jurisdiction → apply CFA India template → simulate → publish (or use production prefill SQL for defaults). Holidays + working days — calendar keys + weekly-off rules. Balances — Employee leave config OB template / Adjust balance. Prove — apply spanning holiday → Approvals approve → check timesheet / attendance sync. Supported leave type catalogue Codes below are the production leave type codes used by CFA India packs and classic catalog. PL means Privilege Leave (earned) — not paternity. Code Name Category Key rules Status PL Privilege Leave Earned Fiscal year; monthly accrual; carry-forward max 45 ; excess LAPSE (or ENCASH if HR re-publishes). Shipped CL Casual Leave Casual Location packs (MH / HR / TN); no carry-forward; lapses at fiscal year end. Not in KA pack. Shipped SL Sick Leave Sick Location packs (KA / HR / TN); medical certificate when ≥3 days; no CF. Shipped MATERNITY Maternity Leave Special Female; min 80 service days; 182 / 182 / 84 / 84 by child #; max start 8 weeks before event; auto end from start; proof required. Shipped PATERNITY Paternity Leave Special Male; 5 consecutive days; window 7 days before or 45 days after event. Shipped MSL Milestone Leave Special Tenure grant at 5/10/15/20y (+ catch-up); 5-day block; partial use forfeits remainder. Shipped WWL Wellness Leave Special KA female; 1 day/month; ±3 day apply window; lapses last working day of month. Shipped COMPOFF Compensatory Off Comp-off Credit from eligible weekend/statutory (≥6h) or weekday (>15h); expire 90 days from work day; encash path staged. Shipped FLOATING Floating Holiday Holiday Calendar-year budget from PH catalogue; employee picks from published options; Jan renew credits entitlement. Shipped UL Unpaid / LOP Unpaid Catalog type for unpaid absence / LOP coupling where enabled. Shipped ADOPTION / MISCARRIAGE Special (catalog) Special Catalog stubs present; entitlement days still TBD with HR . Stub Platform capabilities (policy engine) Jurisdictions & templates Country / region dimensions; apply CFA baseline template into a draft team policy. Versioned publish Draft → simulate / Policy Test Lab → publish. Published versions are immutable. Accrual & carry-forward Schedules LEAVE_ACCRUAL , LEAVE_CARRY_FORWARD , COMP_OFF_EXPIRE . Working days & holidays Weekly-off rules + People holidays filtered by calendar key assignment. Half-day & day count Server recalculates numberOfDays ; excludes weekly offs and matched holidays. Documents & privacy Medical / maternity proof rules; MAT/PAT/WWL privacy masking on sensitive fields. Classic fallback /admin/leave-policies type catalog when Global Leave is off. Multi-country stubs AE / SA / US packs are scaffolded — entitlements still HR-confirm. CFA India location packs (production defaults) Prefill templates ( CFA-IN-* ) ship with production-migration 09-cfa-leave-india-production-prefill.sql . Resolve uses employee work location / region. Pack Location PL CL SL Special / notes CFA-IN-KA Karnataka (Bengaluru) 18 — 12 WWL (female KA); +1 mandatory PH vs other states CFA-IN-MH Maharashtra (Mumbai) 18 7 — Specials + COMPOFF + FLOATING CFA-IN-HR Haryana (Gurugram) 18 8 8 Specials + COMPOFF + FLOATING CFA-IN-TN-CBE Tamil Nadu (Coimbatore) 12 12 12 Lower PL vs other India packs Shared across packs: MATERNITY / PATERNITY / MSL / COMPOFF / FLOATING; fiscal Apr–Mar for earned leave; PL CF max 45 with excess LAPSE by default; PH budget 11 calendar-year floating remainder. Shared special / holiday rules Maternity — 182 days (1st/2nd child), 84 days (3rd+); start ≤8 weeks before expected delivery; FE maps child # to days. Paternity — exactly 5 consecutive days inside apply window. Comp-off — weekend/statutory ≥6h or weekday >15h; 90-day use-or-expire from work day. Floating — pick from published catalogue; reject if catalogue / budget missing. MSL — tenure months 60 / 120 / 180 / 240; catch-up window supported. How to configure leave policies Primary console: Admin → Leave admin → Global Policy Center ( /admin/leave/global-policy-center ). Requires leaveAdditional.globalLeavePoliciesEnabled and adminModules.globalLeavePoliciesEnabled . Enable flags Application Config → org leaveAdditional.leaveManagementEnabled (+ Global Leave / leavePolicies role modules). Minimal flag flips only — do not invent full App Config for NULL-config teams. Create or select a jurisdiction e.g. IN , IN-KA , IN-MH . Used for resolve, holiday calendars, and working-day scope. Apply a country / CFA template into a draft Choose CFA-IN-KA (etc.) or blank draft. Edit type entitlements, accrual, carry-forward, special leave JSON as needed. Simulate / Policy Test Lab Dry-run a sample employee. Lab may gate publish. Guide: Policy Test Lab . Assign holiday calendar key Key must match People → Holidays locations (e.g. IN-KA ). Optionally publish Legal Calendars first. Working-day rules /admin/leave/working-day-rules — team default, jurisdiction pattern, or employee override. “Country” means leave jurisdiction assignment. Publish version Activates accrual / eligibility. Published versions are immutable — clone a new draft to change. Opening balances Employee leave config : Download OB template → fill from ZingHR → dry-run import → live; or Adjust balance per employee. pages.content: Leave Management — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Leave Management Apply and track Balances, a request, and a manager decision Leave management is where people apply, watch balances, submit for approval, and see decisions — with working-week and holiday aware day counts. Policy is authored elsewhere; this is runtime. The working rhythm Open leave, check balance, choose type and dates, review the day count, submit, then watch status. Managers approve or reject with a comment. pages.content: Employee Profile — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Employee Profile One person, many sections The file the employee and HR both touch Profile is the multi-section employee file: general info, security settings, notifications, and account activity. It is the same Employee record the directory opened, not a copy. People → Employees → profile · self profile Route /hrms/profile/:employeeId Employee (self) · HR Admin · Manager (scoped) The job of this console Keep identity, contact, and preference sections true. HR uses the same page for fields the persona is allowed to edit. Security and notification tabs change how that person signs in and is notified — not org-wide templates. Seat at the table Employees edit what self-service allows. HR sees more. Masking still hides salary and bank from personas that should not see them. The working rhythm Open the profile, pick a section, save, confirm the directory and org chart still match. Use Settings for device and org-ops, not this page. Moments that bring you here Name or bank change. A user who cannot receive mail. After a role change. When Employee 360 is used as a deep file — still this record underneath. ⓘ One Employee row Sectioned UI, single source. Persona masking applies on live paths; do not paste unmasked compensation into comments. Flowcharts Each diagram auto-plays when it scrolls into view. Screen layout Hero: Name, title, team, status, avatar. Side nav: General · Security · Notifications · Account activity. Content: Section-specific forms and read-only fields. Activity tab: Timeline with activity charts. Header & filters No SHOW/SORT. Section tabs only. Edit availability depends on whether you view your own profile vs another employee (admin/HR). All charts respect your active filters (SHOW preset, team scope, date range, text search). ◆ Emerald Luxury UI theme · chart data refreshes when filters change Account activity section includes activity timeline charts showing login and action patterns over time. Before you start 💡 First login Upload photo, verify contact info, enable MFA, then review Notifications tab. 📝 SSO accounts Password fields hidden when SSO-only — use corporate IdP for credential changes. Who uses this screen Every employee viewing or editing their own profile; HR administrators editing any employee record opened from the Employees register. Managers may view limited fields for direct reports. ℹ️ Person record detail Profile is the single place for photo, contact info, skills, org placement, security settings, and activity history — distinct from org-wide Settings defaults. Key concepts Profile hero Photo, display name, job title, team, manager, and primary contact channels. Tabbed sections Overview, Security, Notifications, Activity, Skills & org — layout varies by permission. Edit mode Inline or modal edits for fields your role may change — HR edits more than self-service. Security tab Password change, MFA enrollment, active sessions — critical for enterprise SSO hybrids. Activity tab Recent logins and significant actions for security awareness. Permissions Role Access on this screen Individual contributor Edit own contact, photo, notification prefs, password/MFA; view own activity. People manager View direct report profiles; limited field edit (e.g., skills) per policy. HR administrator Full edit on any employee opened from register. Self only (contractor) Restricted tab set — no org admin fields. 📝 Administrator override Org administrators and service accounts configured in the Admin console may bypass row-level scopes shown above. When in doubt, confirm access with your Tracopus administrator. Controls reference Control Description Notes Edit profile Toggle edit on hero fields. Save validates email format. Photo upload Avatar image for Lux shell header. Max size per org policy. Security tab Password, MFA, sessions. SSO users may hide password. Notifications tab Email and in-app toggles per event. Overrides global Settings defaults. Activity tab Login history and actions. Read-only. Skills & org Tags, department, manager link. HR editable. Deactivate (HR) Status change for leavers. HR admin only from register context. Common mistakes ⚠️ Using personal email as primary Breaks SSO and password reset — use corporate email from day one. ⚠️ Skipping MFA setup Enterprise policy may enforce MFA on next login — configure proactively in Security tab. ⚠️ Managers editing compensation Comp fields usually HR-only — well-meaning edits create audit violations. FAQ How is Profile different from Settings? Profile is identity and security; Settings is preferences (locale, timesheet defaults) applying to your account. Can I change my manager? Usually HR-only — self-service manager change would break approval chains. Who sees Activity tab? You see your own; HR may see others when opened from Employees register. Does photo sync to mobile? Yes — avatar appears in mobile app header after save. Related pages Settings Personal preferences separate from identity. Employees Register opens Profile for any row.
